Private Function Shown(value As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(value) Then

Private Function Shown(value As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(value) Then
        Shown = "Null"
    ElseIf IsObject(value) Then
        Shown = "Object:" & TypeName(value)
    Else
        Shown = TypeName(value) & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
End Function
